title: Maintain-loop diagnosis
description: Structured diagnosis of an anomaly, ticket or scan finding. A deterministic wrapper (sdlc.py new --from-json) turns it into changes/<id>/intent.md for human triage.

title.description: Short imperative title, e.g. 'Reduce CI test failure rate after runner image upgrade'.

problem.description: What is wrong and who is affected, in plain language. Under 250 words. State the anomaly, not the fix.

evidence.description: Verifiable facts: metric values with timestamps, band rule hit, run IDs, log excerpts, commit SHAs, links. No secrets or personal data.

proposed_outcome.description: What better looks like (e.g. 'failure rate back inside the 1-sigma band'), not an implementation.

affected_systems.description: Services, repositories, pipelines and user groups involved.

constraints.description: Limits on any fix (e.g. 'no production access', 'freeze until Friday').

open_questions.description: What the diagnosis could not establish and a human must answer.

tier.description: Proposed ceremony tier: bounded (one component, clear fix), standard (several components or user-visible), high-risk (auth, payments, PII, migrations, infra, hard to roll back).
